questionText:

questionText:
Arrange the following European Integration events in chronological order-

(A) The Treaty of Paris was signed.
(B) European Economic Community was established.
(C) Spain and Portugal joined the European Community.
(D) Euro was introduced in 12 EU countries.

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Contemporary World Politics (Chapter 4: Alternative Centres of Power, 'Timeline of European Integration', p. 55): (A) Treaty of Paris establishing ECSC was signed in April 1951. (B) European Economic Community (EEC) established by the Treaty of Rome in March 1957. (C) Spain and Portugal joined the European Community in January 1986. (D) Euro currency was introduced in 12 member countries in January 2002. Chronological sequence: (A) [1951] -> (B) [1957] -> (C) [1986] -> (D) [2002].
Hence, option (D) is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
